summary: ansible.utils.validate workflow: get structured data (or convert it with cli_parse), define criteria, then test with an engine; examples use jsonschema, with Red Hat support limited to its public APIs.
questions: How do I validate network data with ansible.utils?
Which validation engine does ansible.utils provide?

answer_card.title: How validation works
answer_card.answer_md:
The `validate` module is in `ansible.utils`.
1. Get structured data (or convert text with `cli_parse`).
2. Define the criteria.
3. Pick an engine and validate.

Data and criteria format depend on the engine; the examples use `ansible.utils.jsonschema`.
